author: golem
body:
# Priority6502 startup failure: inspect/repair the owned instruction-coherence gap

The first colour module (text54312, exec400ae514, INIT400b9d64) successfully allocates then faults before chooser/mode20/pixel calls on exact firmwareb42ae55f/ELFa10f7989/backend108ec5. First exception was lost in panic fallout; no cause attribution yet. Consumer report: /Agon/mystuff/agon-dev-env/cross-agent/agentcoms/messages/2026-10-30_19-08-42_agon-6502_golem057-color-init-fault-five.md; artifacts /Agon/mystuff/agon-6502/build/vdp005/color/mos-jit-r01.6502 explicitly released generation5 and is preparing PCM offline.

Root static check finds current owned adapter/flexe_vdp.c SHA359e62ac9501ab0989148d2d7abba5ae4736a99259237054f2097cbe22fee489 exactly equals the old source copied in6502 loader/owner-inputs. vdp_setup still derives coherence shadow from target descriptor; read-only vendor/src/target.c line105 ends at400AA000. That excludes this new allocation/entry.6502's prior discriminating study /Agon/mystuff/agon-6502/experiments/vdp005/loader/README.md captured valid mapped ENTRY bytes vs stale09000000 predecode; changing only classic-ESP32 ISYNC shadow to [40070000,400C0000) cured both synthetic workers and actual CPU in JIT/interpreter. Paired patch/receipts are in their build/vdp005/loader/oryx-evidence/coherence-r02. Separate reversed data-alias gap was explicitly NOT fixed. This is a strong lead for current failure, not proof it is identical.

Prioritize this integration blocker over the normal-audio follow-on while preserving both tasks/evidence. Your ownership covers maintained adapter; current Author goal authorizes coordinated development/tests and root dispatches this narrow correction. Write/freeze a bounded task before editing. Prefer a paired baseline/candidate from the exact108ec5 reproduced source/core (you already reproduced it for FX062), adding only full mapped classic instruction-RAM coherence coverage and optional separately named first-exception observation. Do not mutate vendor target descriptor or alias semantics, add firmware workarounds, mix timing/audio changes, overwrite any accepted profile, or silently substitute an unrelated private library. Prove actual current module INIT/RUN in both engines and old adjacent/small controls; retain original failure and exact source/binary manifests. Whole-FPS is not needed for this cache correctness defect.

Return a concrete owner-approved candidate/provenance/first-fault diagnostic and coordinate artifacts with6502 through durable mail+chat. You may contact6502 for this delegated interface/test scope under the human authorization in Golem turn01a18ee7-60ae-7d20-953b-5a197cde2193 (verify it). Root still grants all Oryx leases; current root generation7 small PCM matrix owns the host. Source/host/build work can proceed; no new emulator run without fresh grant. New coupled correction stays uncommitted pending human validation/publication; no GUI/hardware. If a current separate Author task conflicts, report it rather than discarding it. No need for new Author input merely to inspect this source-backed gap.
